description: Stage 4 and Stage 5 currently re-run the full 3-reviewer ensemble on the entire pull request diff even when nothing reviewable changed (such as mechanical target merges, bookkeeping-only commits, or timing-gate/infrastructure pipeline failures after consensus approval) and re-review unchanged code in full after small resolver deltas.
goal: Ensure the 3-reviewer ensemble runs on the full pull request diff once per version of the reviewable change and never due to non-reviewable churn: (1) anchor consensus approval to the pull request's own reviewable diff (excluding bookkeeping files) so approval is withdrawn only when that diff changes — never by a mechanical target merge, bookkeeping commits, or a pipeline result; (2) route pipeline failures after approval without erasing approval of unchanged code — rerun CI noise failures (timing gate, runner/infrastructure failures, cancelled runs) while keeping consensus intact, and route real test failures to the resolver with scoped review of only the fix delta; (3) run conflict resolution before ensemble reviewers so conflicting PRs merge target first, preserving approval on mechanical merges (no conflicts, or append-only ledger and knowledge-base files only) and running a scoped delta review on resolved code conflicts; (4) execute scoped delta reviews against the delta since the last reviewed head together with full file context around modified files and the addressed findings, falling back to full review when the delta exceeds a configured size limit; (5) store and check consensus-on-diff and pipeline-green-on-head as independent conjunction gates so losing one does not erase the other; and (6) count and report full reviews, scoped reviews, pipeline runs, and non-defect churn counts in the flow summary and calibration report.
rationale: Full 3-reviewer iterations are the largest working-time cost in the pipeline; decoupling diff approval from pipeline noise and scoping follow-up delta reviews eliminates repeated full-diff reviewer churn and spurious new nits on previously approved code.
acceptance_criteria: Consensus approval is keyed to the reviewable own diff (excluding bookkeeping files) and survives mechanical target merges, bookkeeping-only commits, and CI noise failures (timing gate, runner/infra, cancelled runs) without withdrawing approval or re-running the 3-reviewer ensemble.
Real CI test failures after approval dispatch the resolver and review only the resulting fix delta rather than invalidating approval on unchanged files.
Conflict checks execute before ensemble reviewers so conflicting PRs merge target first instead of running reviewers on a dirty/conflicting head.

Scoped delta reviews supply the delta since the last reviewed head, full file contents around modified files, and addressed findings, falling back to full review only when the delta exceeds a configurable size limit.
Consensus-on-diff and pipeline-green-on-head are stored and checked as independent conjunction gates.
Flow summary and calibration report record counts for full reviews, scoped reviews, pipeline runs, and churn caused by non-defect events.
All unit tests pass via 'uv run pytest', 'uv run task lint' passes, and all touched modules stay within holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json.
